about.en: SharonAI bStock (SHAZB) is a tokenized share of SharonAI Holdings Inc. issued by BTECH Holdings Ltd, a special purpose vehicle registered in the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), under Binance's bStocks brand. It is a BEP-20 token on BNB Chain at 0x0f31e21b7881f5583ea94ddbcb0bcaf22b1abeab, backed 1:1 by SHAZ shares and convertible 1:1 with the underlying equity, with stock splits and dividend adjustments processed by the issuer. bStocks are offered under an ADGM-approved prospectus and not in other jurisdictions.
